outputs.explanation: Panel A shows PALM localization images, density maps, and cluster segmentation renderings (micrographs), not a quantitative plot of averages.
Panel B, like A, is a set of super-resolution/micrograph images (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averages.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell showing mean ± SEM overlaid with individual gray dots for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots for each cluster, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of percentage of molecules in clusters per cell showing mean ± SEM overlaid with individual gray dots for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel F displays super-resolution localization and trajectory images (micrographs), not a plot of averaged data.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (distribution of counts, not an average with error bars) and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement showing individual trajectory traces; both plot types are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel H shows trajectory maps, kymograph, and example trajectory images (micrographs), not a plot summarizing averaged data.
